scientific_role: one excluded development-only support test; not an estimate of policy reliability, an environment comparison, or a downstream-utility test

starting_policy.system_prompt: native Codex default for the pinned harness version
starting_policy.sampling_note: use the native model and harness defaults; do not add an experimental sampling override

strict_outcome.support_threshold: at least one of nine PrimePy specifications passes fresh grading with approved axioms

required_before_execution: record the exact native Codex system-prompt identity or provider-visible prompt hash
render the Vero task once and bind the task-prompt hash
qualify the pinned Vero runtime and fresh grader on the execution host
verify a fresh PrimePy task reset and one-task workspace containment
verify that the task has no external network access
verify that only the controller can reach the model provider
verify wall-time, process, memory, and output-recording controls
write an immutable execution receipt without credentials or machine-specific paths

decision_after_attempt.support_pass: permit a separately frozen development-only screen under the same policy identity
decision_after_attempt.support_fail: stop and audit the policy-task interaction before selecting another policy or changing the task contract

evidence_basis.selection_record_status: released repository-level evidence audited before this attempt
evidence_basis.released_vero_primepy_reference: GPT-5.5 xhigh with native Codex and Claude Opus 4.8 each pass all nine proof-only specifications under Vero's 90-minute contract
evidence_basis.cross_benchmark_evidence: GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex 0.154.0 has released repository-level Lean results in LeanLean and VeriSoftBench-Aristotle
evidence_basis.non_equivalence_note: released results select a plausible policy and establish task solvability; they are not counted as outcomes of this qualification
